coverage_rule: Include only named individual characters whose basic first-volume roles/actions are directly stated in the selected VIZ Vol. 1 product page or VIZ's first-volume editorial overview: Tanjiro Kamado, Nezuko Kamado, Giyu, and Sakonji Urokodaki. No named demon, further Corps member, or later character is added without a direct first-volume claim. The official Chapter 1 reader establishes availability but its accessible view does not offer stable text/page/panel anchors, so it does not justify visual-panel reconstruction. Demon Slayer Corps/roles, demons as a category, breathing styles, blood arts, items, places, transformations, and themes remain terms/dimensions.

content_cautions: VIZ rates the selected volume Teen. Its first-volume material includes a demon slaughtering a family, a child/younger sibling surviving after transformation into a demon, threats of killing that sibling, man-eating demons, snowy wilderness danger, swords, and demon-hunting violence.

VIZ's editorial calls the foes frightening and depicts a family-loss/transformation premise. This audit avoids panel reproduction and does not catalogue every Vol. 1 depiction of blood, injury, body horror, or child/family harm; readers should use the primary volume and relevant content guidance for those specifics.
uncertainties: The accessible Chapter 1 page identifies an official reader but does not provide reliably addressable text/panel locators in this research environment. Character facts are restricted to VIZ's explicitly first-volume editorial/product descriptions and not inferred from images or memory.

VIZ situates the fiction in Taisho-era Japan and gives the historical period's 1912–1926 dates, but the demon plot, Corps, transformations, and individuals are fictional. This pass makes no claim that any character/event is historical or that the setting accurately reproduces all Taisho history.
The VIZ Vol. 1 page does not list a translator/adaptor/letterer for this English edition. No such credit is guessed here.
evidence_basis: VIZ's Vol. 1 page establishes the selected English edition and names Tanjiro and Giyu in the immediate setup. VIZ's first-volume editor overview directly identifies Tanjiro, Nezuko, Giyu, and Sakonji Urokodaki and states their limited setup actions/roles; it also explains the Taisho-period fiction context and first-volume Corps/sword framing. VIZ's Chapter 1 page establishes official primary chapter availability without supporting unaddressable panel claims. SEGA's official game page establishes that The Hinokami Chronicles is based on the anime, not a substitute for the selected manga witness. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, anime/film/game playthrough, guidebook, or later manga material supplies character claims.
